---
title: "Working with membership tables"
author: J.R. Ferrer-Paris 
---

This is an example with our internal dataset, first take a look at the data structure

```{r}
library(ecoSynthesis)
data("TASVEG_mini", package = "ecoSynthesis")
head(TASVEG_mini)
```

Here we can use the function membership_tbl directly (need to adjust table column names).

```{r}
#| eval: false
TASVEG_tbl <- membership_tbl(TASVEG_mini, "VEGCODE", "efg", "memb", "expert")
class(TASVEG_tbl)
print(TASVEG_tbl)
check_membership(TASVEG_tbl)
validate_membership(TASVEG_tbl)
```
